text:
rachel: dropped a tiny prototype for the trace actions header. core question: make Export visible (tertiary button) or keep it in overflow? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-proto/trace-actions :mag:

omar: I lean overflow. Export is heavy and clutters the toolbar. power users will find it in kebab or via shortcut.

ivy: agree overflow for most users, but can we add a subtle Discover link in the header that explains Export formats (CSV/JSON) for new users? small help icon that opens a tooltip.

kevin: Copy flow: propose a single "Copy" button that opens a tiny menu with Trace ID / Request ID / Correlation chain. Primary click copies Trace ID. This keeps header compact and reduces accidental copies.

rachel: nice. we should also add an inline confirmation that's accessible (aria-live polite) and a visual microstate (check icon) for 1.2s. respect prefers-reduced-motion.

a11y-bot: accessibility notes: 1) Copy menu trigger needs aria-haspopup=true and aria-expanded toggled. 2) Success announcement must include the value copied, not just "Copied". 3) Export dialog must use role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and trap focus. 4) Ensure color contrast for icons >=4.5:1.

omar: export dialog: show two presets by default (Frames CSV, Event JSON) + an advanced toggle to pick columns. show a tiny sample preview and an estimated byte size. backend can provide size hints.

kevin: also add a small checkbox "Include trace context (service, endpoint)" default on. that helps support teams. if size > threshold, warn and suggest JSON.

ivy: wording nit: change "Download" to explicit verbs: "Export frames (CSV)", "Export full event (JSON)", "Get permalink". tooltips should be one line + optional detail in the modal.

rachel: mobile: collapse Copy into kebab; keep Open and Back visible. chips for correlation ids collapse into a single "IDs" control on phone.

a11y-bot: keyboard: Enter/Space to open menus, Arrow keys to navigate, Escape to close. after closing any modal/menu, return focus to the trigger. ensure tab order is logical across clusters.

omar: small UX: if export estimate is large (>5MB), show a badge and suggest streaming or filtered export. also allow scheduling export (email/download link).

kevin: implementational note: split button semantics can be tricky. let's add clear aria-labels for the primary and caret parts, and test with NVDA/JAWS.

ivy: I'll update the prototype with split copy button, overflow-only export, discover tooltip, and export modal preview + size hint. will annotate aria attributes. can ux/a11y review when done?

rachel: yes please. target: upload updated frames by EOD so we can groom with eng next sprint. thanks all. :sparkles:
